name: xflickr_error_rate

query_condition.sql: SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE outcome='error') * 100.0 / nullif(count(*),0) AS error_rate FROM "xflickr_calls" HAVING error_rate > 5

description: Impact: More than 5 percent of Flickr calls fail over 15 minutes. Action: Inspect error codes and retry patterns.
